about: Buy or sell a unit in a freehold area through the Dubai Now app, signing with UAE PASS.
note: Requirements read from the official Dubai Land Department service page on the checked date. The sign-in forms do not publish their field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Buy or sell a property via Dubai Now. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: For individuals who hold a UAE ID
The property must be free of restrictions and mortgages and in a freehold area
Only subdivided units such as apartments, offices and townhouses
The sale amount and fees go through an escrow account
fees: 2% of the value from the seller and 2% from the buyer
AED 250 for the title deed and AED 250 for a villa or apartment map
AED 30 innovation fee and AED 30 knowledge fee
AED 1,000 plus VAT service partner fee if the value is AED 500,000 or more, otherwise AED 500 plus VAT
